data.name: Review.Startup.ScopeNote
data.value: Checked Run/RunOnce in HKCU, Run/RunOnce in HKLM (32/64-bit on x64), and the current-account and all-users Startup folders. Scheduled tasks, services, extensions, and other mechanisms are not listed. The presence of an entry does not prove enabled startup, performance impact, or maliciousness. Shortcuts are shown as files; their targets are not resolved.

data.value: The application is elevated. HKCU and the personal Startup folder belong to the stated process account, which may differ from the interactive desktop user.
